answer: The cooper's yard smells of oak and iron, and every barrel there carries the cooper's own brand burned into the head. Proof of cooper barrel via hoop drive tally is the branding: a barrel the cooper seals only after 9 hoops are driven true, each hoop struck by the cooper himself. The cipher is the first hoop, driven when the staves were green; the umber is the ninth, driven when the barrel first held water. A cheat must drive 15 false hoops and brand 15 false barrels, and the island still holds no ale at all.
